Section 18 already names RWB-S9-E2019-APP for the firm and binding; this contract declares no partner table and no token.

disposition.target: TSD S9 (T-A.1, T-A.2, T3.1) and RWB-S9-E2019-APP

disposition.change: Move the partner_user DDL V_E2_019__partner_user.sql and the reference load handler to the S9 story set; keep session, role and scope checks in rwb-access.

disposition.target: TSD P4 v3 (appendix T-A and T3.2) and the API Specification
disposition.change: Register the partner identity resolution operation with its schema; state whether PLACED is a session scope descriptor or role default scope; state answer lifetime against the partner edge token lifetime.
disposition.note: The values are confirmed at contract review with the gateway and rwb-partner owners. The build reads them at run time.

disposition.target: Security design decision, Service Catalog and gateway runbook
disposition.change: Fix the DMZ zone design, gateway product and version, client authentication, token lifetimes, identity provider, certificate and rate-limit values, WAF rule set and DR objectives before the penetration test.

disposition.change: Add rows for TC-E2-019-CON-01 to TC-E2-019-CON-06 with Given, When and Then copied from the criterion each covers.
disposition.note: The rows are missing from Test Cases v8; the story test list in section 16 already names them.

disposition.change: Align the REQ-ACA-012 test list with section 18 of RWB-P4-E2019-CON (TC-E2-019-CON-01 to TC-E2-019-CON-08).
